caption: The drawing shows a figure of a leaping stag positioned in profile, facing left. The stag’s body is brown, with darker shades used for shading and a lighter underbelly. It has a pair of antlers and its mouth is open with a red tongue visible. The stag is decorated with a harness-like covering and saddle that is primarily tan with accents of greenish-blue and red. There is a silver or grey circular element at the base of the neck where the harness joins. The saddle area on the stag’s back is red-bordered with tan and greenish-blue outlines. The stag's body is shown with well-defined muscle structure and its legs are bent in a leaping posture. The background is a plain, off-white color with no additional objects or scenery.
title: Carousel Reindeer
